portraits.finalPrompt:
Create a wholly new Knight illustration from scratch. Do not retouch or inherit facial texture from Image 1.

Image roles:
1. Image 1 is ONLY the exact pose, crop, equipment-layout, and safe-silhouette blueprint. Match its close scale, large left/right empty columns, screen-left gaze, torso turn, crossing forearms, high screen-left sword placement, and vertically falling narrow cloak shape.
2-3. Facial-medium references only: learn their premium watercolor/gouache anime rendering, luminous colored skin, clear expressive eyes, elegant stylized planes, restrained blush, and grouped painterly hair. Do not copy identities, feminine anatomy, hair colors, costume, staff, or magic.
4-5. Medium/age references only; do not copy identity, costume, or scenery.

Subject: one handsome adult masculine Knight, early thirties, strong straight nose, angular jaw, warm olive-peach skin, alert hazel-brown eyes looking screen-left, short dark-brown wind-tossed hair, controlled natural stubble. Fresh high-quality anime-watercolor face: soft colored planes, clear brows/eyes/mouth, subtle circulation at cheeks/ears/lips, painted hair masses, selective crisp accents. No pores, etched realism, muddy skin, waxiness, harsh photoreal planes, overworked texture, or copied feminine face.

LOCKED PRACTICAL GESTURE: exactly ONE bare flesh hand and exactly ONE armored gauntlet. The upper hand at SCREEN-RIGHT is completely bare human skin—five correct bare fingers, bare palm and knuckles—emerging from a quiet brown leather wrist bracer. That bare hand crosses inward and tightens the cuff/strap of the opposite fully armored articulated steel gauntlet. The lower crossing hand/forearm is the fully armored gauntlet with five coherent metal fingers. Do not put metal finger plates on the bare tightening hand. Do not make both hands armored or both hands bare. Hands do not fuse and no extra fingers.

Recreate practical iron armor and chain, neutral leather, muted brass, and one dominant weathered vermilion cloak. Sword is carried high at screen-left waist behind the bent armored forearm: pommel inward/up-right, guard down-left, scabbard continuing diagonally through the BOTTOM only. Every grip, joint, guard, pommel, buckle and suspension is visible and physically coherent. The cloak falls vertically close to the body and must not flare horizontally.

Hard composition: preserve Image 1's same close head-to-mid-thigh scale and no-wider-than-78-percent silhouette. Leave at least 10 percent continuous empty background along the ENTIRE left edge and 10 percent along the ENTIRE right edge; leave at least 7 percent above all hair. Nothing—hair, cloak, shoulder, elbow, hand, armor, sword hardware, or stray pixel—may enter those top/side safety bands. Only lower clothing, lower cloak, and the long scabbard may continue through the horizontal bottom.

Backdrop: perfectly uniform, opaque, unlit PURE CHROMA MAGENTA #FF00FF in every non-character pixel and every gap. The top and both side border bands must be a single exact saturated magenta with no variation. No transparency, checkerboard, green, gradient, texture, shadow, glow, rim light, white/off-white separation, paper fade, dry-brush edge, scenery, particles, frame, text, UI, or watermark.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: opaque chroma-key source for a premium painterly-anime mobile RPG portrait. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target and composition/identity source. Images 2 and 3 are facial-rendering references only: learn their soft watercolor-gouache anime facial planes, luminous living skin, restrained blush, clean expressive eye shapes, elegant noses and mouths, and naturally grouped painted hair strands. Never copy their identities, feminine anatomy, pink/silver hair, clothing, props, pose, or palette. Images 4 and 5 are medium references only. Preserve the target's unique age, gender presentation, ethnicity, facial bone structure, hair color/style, expression, gaze direction, and personality; do not make a same-face cohort.

Change ONLY the rendering treatment of the face, ears, neck, exposed skin, and hair. Repaint those regions freshly at high quality so they feel like the same living person rendered in the Priest/Sorcerer visual language: clearly anime-esque rather than realistic, attractive and expressive, softly modeled colored skin rather than gray or photographic skin, selective crisp eyelashes/brows/irises, subtle warm circulation around cheeks/ears/lips, and painterly hair masses with a few deliberate flyaways. Remove etched skin texture, pores, muddy desaturation, waxiness, hard photoreal planes, oversharpening, and generational-edit artifacts. Keep anatomy credible and age appropriate.

Everything below the hairline/neck is locked: exact pose, gesture, body proportions, shoulder angle, clothing construction, equipment, hand anatomy, object relationships, single-accent palette, lighting direction, crop, and silhouette. Do not add, remove, simplify, relocate, or redesign any garment, hand, weapon, tool, strap, buckle, pouch, jewelry, or prop. Preserve the candid off-camera observed moment. No direct eye contact or presentation smile. Head-to-mid-thigh portrait; same face size and eye-line; no zoom, stretch, widening, or restaging. Output one character against a perfectly uniform opaque high-chroma matte, with uninterrupted matte above the complete hair and down both sides. Nothing may touch or exit the top or side edges; only lower clothing or a long downward prop may crop through the bottom. Character pigment meets matte directly: no white/off-white separation, halo, rim light, paper texture, dry-brush fade, glow, scenery, shadow, particles, text, UI, or watermark.

Repaint her with the soft luminous anime-watercolor facial language: living warm peach skin, subtle sun warmth and freckles, clear green irises, expressive but unsmiling mouth, and copper hair grouped into fluid painted masses with gold-russet variation. Keep her distinct from Wizard and Priest, outdoors-capable rather than glamorous, and do not alter bow geometry, string, grip, hands, clothing, braid silhouette, or pose. Use a perfectly uniform pure chroma-magenta matte.
